lines: A barren sandpit, thunderbolts darting overhead — lives worn down by worthless noise
For the next thousand years not even grass will grow — it's a planet of sand
Fated to grind away like this, going nowhere — a satellite falling from orbit
Covered in signs that say KEEP OUT — it's a planet of sand
Wandering aimlessly, drifting about, I arrived at a prayer
If you're still alive, even now, answer me
Yeah, today goes down — in other words, bye bye bye, back to the way things were
If an idea comes to you, walk toward it — leave nothing behind to regret
Yeah, a thunderstorm slicing the sky — its rumble ringing out, bye bye bye
Let's stay friends just a little longer, this time around
Come to think of it, today's our happy birthday — let's decorate it however we like
Let's gather around a cake that's nothing but sugar and sing a song
A salute before the graves of the nameless masses — yes, lives born of a Melt Shock
Before this well runs dry, let's hurry up and get out of here
Hey, hey, hey — how about a rendezvous, just you and me? What do you think about, in this desert already gone to ruin?
Now's the time — dash out quick, my hero. We beseech thee: save us, who have lost our way
Let's blast off even further — on your marks, get set, A-OK!
That dance hall, deep behind the mosaic — an out-of-place artifact from the Archean age
Bang bang bang with ray guns — boys and girls singing their theories of hope
Earth-shaking, and the most unprecedented memory of all is an electronic sound
Bewildered, sorrowful, raging mad, I arrived at a prayer
If your heart is not yet dead, respond — and quickly
Yeah, surely boys don't cry — in other words, bye bye bye, until we make up
If you remember it, tell me — that song like a dream of chaos
Yeah, a laser beam dancing through the void — when it points somewhere far away, bye bye bye
Guide us to the castle in the sky
Let's sing and dance, happy birthday — let's plant an apple tree in the desert
Tumble head over heels, and that's bye bye — the rest, anyone can do as they please
